fusions.name: Leap and Settle
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto the target and settle on it, dealing 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Nips
fusions.desc: Flicks a biting speck that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Unlikely Bound
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and you regain 12 health as you land.

fusions.name: Hop Between Rests
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
